Title: Monthly revenue and profit — NZD
Fields: X: DimDate[Year Month]; Y: [Total Revenue], [Total Profit]; tooltip: [Total Orders], [Profit Margin %]
Configuration: Sort Year Month ascending. Revenue teal; profit blue. Default interaction: filter.

Title: Revenue by channel — NZD
Configuration: Whole ring context; labels show channel and %. Channel colors fixed across pages.

Title: Revenue by year — NZD
Configuration: Label 2019 partial in title/footer. Sort year ascending.

Title: Comparable annual performance
Fields: Rows: DimDate[Year]; Values: [Revenue Through Comparable Cutoff], [Revenue PY Through Comparable Cutoff], [Revenue Comparable YoY %]
Configuration: 2019 uses Jan 1-Dec 12; other complete years use calendar year. Turn off grand total because measures need one year.

Title: Product financial performance — NZD
Fields: Rows: DimProduct[Product Name]; Values: [Total Revenue], [Total Profit], [Profit Margin %], [Total Quantity]
Configuration: Revenue DESC; data bars on revenue; diverging colors on margin. All selected products; no top filter.

Title: Quantity vs margin
Fields: X: [Total Quantity]; Y: [Profit Margin %]; Size: [Total Revenue]; Details/Values: DimProduct[Product Name]
Configuration: Each product must be a separate bubble; verify selected point count. Tooltip revenue, profit, ASP. Do not draw unsupported high/low quadrants.

Title: Top 5 products by revenue — NZD
Fields: Y: DimProduct[Product Name]; X: [Total Revenue]; tooltip: [Total Profit], [Profit Margin %]
Configuration: Visual filter: Product Position <=5 AND is not blank. Revenue DESC. Never native Top N + rank universe.

Title: Bottom 5 products by revenue — NZD
Fields: Y: DimProduct[Product Name]; X: [Total Revenue]; tooltip: [Total Profit], [Profit Margin %]
Configuration: Visual filter: Product Bottom Position <=5 AND is not blank. Revenue ASC. Exactly five where available.

Title: Top 10 customers — NZD
Fields: Y: DimCustomer[Customer Names]; X: [Total Revenue]; tooltip: [Total Orders], [Average Order Value], [Customer Position]
Configuration: Customer Position <=10 AND not blank. Sort revenue DESC. Card concentration must not receive this visual filter.

Title: Customer revenue distribution — NZD
Configuration: All selected customers, revenue DESC; category distribution, NOT a numeric histogram. Hide crowded axis labels; use tooltips.

Title: Customer Pareto — NZD
Fields: X: DimCustomer[Customer Names]; Column Y: [Total Revenue]; Line Y: [Customer Pareto Cumulative Tied %], [Pareto 80% Target]
Configuration: All selected customers, NO Top N. Sort revenue DESC. Line secondary axis 0-1 formatted %. Tie-aware cumulative; final point 100%.

Title: Customer by year — NZD
Fields: Rows: DimCustomer[Customer Names]; Columns: DimDate[Year]; Values: [Total Revenue], [Customer Revenue Share %]
Configuration: Revenue data bars. Share is within year, not whole matrix grand total. Scroll allowed.

Title: Regional revenue — NZD
Fields: Location: DimRegion[Region Label]; Latitude: DimRegion[Latitude]; Longitude: DimRegion[Longitude]; Size: [Total Revenue]
Configuration: Coordinates Do not summarize; marker/bubble size revenue; tooltip revenue, profit, margin, orders, full address. NZ geographic extent. Do not substitute aggregated city centroids.

Title: Top 10 regions — NZD
Configuration: Native visual Top N 10 by Total Revenue; no share/rank/Pareto denominator here. Revenue DESC; exact tie count not guaranteed.

Title: Region by channel — NZD
Fields: Rows: DimRegion[Region Label]; Columns: DimChannel[Channel]; Values: [Total Revenue]
Configuration: Keep all selected regions; optional city hierarchy before region label. Grand totals on.

Title: Warehouse performance
Fields: Rows: DimWarehouse[Warehouse Code]; Values: [Total Orders], [Total Revenue], [Average Lead Time], [Late Shipment %]
Configuration: Warehouse metrics by ORDER date. Include conditional colors for late %; no invented target.

Title: Lead-time distribution by order date
Fields: X: FactSales[Lead Time (days)] (Do not summarize); Y: [Total Orders]
Configuration: Sort lead days ASC. Numeric x bins are exact days, no synthetic column required.

Title: Late shipments by ship month
Fields: X: DimDate[Year Month]; Column Y: [Late Orders by Ship Date]; Line Y: [Late Shipment % by Ship Date]
Configuration: Secondary line axis 0-1 %. Order date drill-through disabled here. Use special ship-period target defined in guide.

Title: Average lead time by warehouse
Fields: Y: DimWarehouse[Warehouse Code]; X: [Average Lead Time]
Configuration: Order-date cohort; sort days DESC. Label calendar days.

Title: Order-level detail
Fields: Order Number; Order Date; Ship Date; Customer Names; Product Name; Region Label; Channel; Warehouse Code; Currency Code; Order Quantity; Unit Price; Total Unit Cost; Total Revenue; Total Cost; Profit; Lead Time (days); [Total Revenue]; [Total Cost]; [Total Profit]
Configuration: Rename raw fields for this visual to Revenue/Cost/Profit (original); converted measures to Revenue/Cost/Profit (NZD). Raw fields Do not summarize; totals OFF to avoid mixed-currency sums. Horizontal scroll expected.
